title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: refuse the per-item publish and a package-less save over a binding to an uninstalled package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XA5xtdrvS2hp5TUtrhbCBWH)_

Fixes #26921

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: not needed — no `skills/**` page teaches a save naming no package over a package-bound item or the per-item publish (`git grep` on `skills/` for `/publish` and `discard-drafts` finds one row, the `publish-drafts` event in `skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-hooks.md`, which this does not change); the docs paragraph in `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` is updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已经绑在"未安装包"上的旧元数据行，不再能被延续或发布：不带 `?package=` 的保存（草稿和直接保存）若沿用了这种绑定，回 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`；单项发布 `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish`（带或不带 `?package=`）若草稿会发布到这种包里，同样回 422。什么都不写，也不迁移、不删除旧行。
- 为什么改：#26920 堵住了"新建"幽灵绑定，但旧库里已有的幽灵行仍能被无包保存继续写、被单项发布推上线，上线后没有命名空间、无法卸载或导出。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧两个请求，不改存储形状；旧幽灵行照常可读、可删（`DELETE ?package=ID`）、可丢草稿（`discard-drafts`），装上同名包后又能正常保存和发布（实测）。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 里 `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal`（新增的 `how` 参数与三种句子）、`saveMetaItem` 中紧跟包地址解析之后的继承分支、`promoteDraftForPublish` 中地址解析之后的发布分支。
- 两分钟验证：在一个 #26920 之前写过 `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/x?package=com.example.nosuch` 的库上启动本分支，`PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/x`（不带包）与 `POST /api/v1/meta/dashboard/x/publish?package=com.example.nosuch` 都应回 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`，`GET` 读到的行不变。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`** — two more doors ask the one named-base rule (`uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal`, the helper the save door and the flow arm ask since #26708), about a binding the caller did not name but the item's stored rows give:
  - **A save naming no package**, draft or active. Right after the save's address is resolved (the publish-mode `packagelessAddress`, and for a draft save the `packagelessDraftAddress` the object overlay check already read, now read once for every type), the package that address lands in must be installed. Refused `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` with `packageId` = that id, before anything is written: "Cannot save TYPE 'NAME' without naming a package: its stored rows are bound to package 'ID', which is not installed in this deployment, and this save would extend that binding. …". It is never re-homed package-less in silence. Saves naming a package (already judged as named), the server-stated rewrites (`migrate-stored`, `package-duplicate`) and an ambiguous draft address (the repository's `409`, as before) are not asked.
  - **The per-item publish** (`promoteDraftForPublish`, so `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` named or not): right after the draft address is resolved, the package the draft goes live in must be installed. Refused the same way before the draft is read: "Cannot publish TYPE 'NAME' into package 'ID': no package with that id is installed in this deployment, so the TYPE would go live bound to a package that does not exist. …".
  - Same rule, envelope and code; the helper takes `how: { verb?, inherited? }` and only the sentence changes. The flow arm's sentence and the named-save sentence are byte for byte unchanged. Both new sentences name the way out that exists for such rows: create a package with that id, or remove the rows bound to it (a delete naming the id; `discard-drafts` for drafts) and save again. They stay under the REST door's 500-character client message bound for ordinary names (measured: a first draft of the save sentence was cut by `truncateClientMessage`).
  - ⛔ No stored row is migrated or deleted; no error code was added; `packages/spec` is untouched.
- Docs: the package-first authoring paragraph in `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`; changeset `26921-named-base-stored-binding.md` (patch, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## Why

After #26708 (PR #26920) a save or a `publish-drafts` naming an uninstalled package id is refused, but rows bound to such an id that a database already holds (written before that change) could still be extended or published by two doors: a save naming no package inherited the phantom binding (#11087's rule), and the per-item publish served a phantom-bound draft live. Such an item has no manifest, so no namespace, and no uninstall or export.

**Measure-first (the order's stop condition on the inherit arm): a refusal does NOT strand a published phantom row.** On a database written by `main` before #26920 (`7eb613c3`), with five dashboards bound to `com.example.nosuch` (active only, active + draft, draft only): `DELETE /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME` answered 200 and removed the active row, with `?package=com.example.nosuch` too; `DELETE …?state=draft&package=com.example.nosuch` discarded the draft; and `POST /api/v1/packages` with that id answered 201, after which a save naming no package over the row answered 200. The served item read already reports `deletable: true`. So the arm was implemented, not handed back.

## Tests

- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-stored-binding.test.ts` (16 tests). Rows are written the way they were in production: saved while the package was installed, then the package leaves the registry. Refusals (11): the per-item publish named (dashboard, page), naming none over a phantom draft, naming none over a phantom active row; a save naming no package over a phantom active row (dashboard, page × draft, active); a draft save over a lone phantom draft. Each asserts `code`, `status`, `packageId`, the first sentence, rows unchanged and nothing registered or inserted. Controls (5): saves and publishes over an installed package's rows, package-less items, and the delete naming the id still removing the row.
- Red first: with `protocol.ts` at the base blob (`c3c93949`, written over and restored by hash), the file fails 11 of 16; the 5 controls pass.
- Fixtures (each now installs the package its rows are bound to, ⛔ none widens the rule): `protocol.batch-verb-driver-code.test.ts`, `protocol.batch-verb-driver-text.test.ts` and `protocol.destructive-409-face-inventory.test.ts` (their registry double gains `getPackage` for `com.acme.crm`); `objectql/src/protocol-sentinel-owner-draft-save-address.test.ts` (installs `com.qa.p` / `com.qa.q`, as `protocol-adopt-orphans-object-registry.test.ts` does).
- `protocol.package-closure-gate.test.ts` › "narrows NOTHING when the registry cannot produce the written package" pinned exactly the promotion this card refuses (a draft promoted after its package left the registry, unnarrowed, `success: true`). Replaced, not narrowed: renamed to "a promotion into a package the registry cannot produce is refused before the closure gate"; the installed leg still asserts the closure refusal, the uninstalled leg now asserts `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`.

- Package suites (vitest, `--maxWorkers=2`, under the verify lock), after rebuilding `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` so the consumers read the changed `dist/`:

<details><summary>Counts</summary>

- On the final head `6135db9b`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 277 files passed / 4 skipped, 21749 tests passed / 26 skipped; `@objectstack/objectql` 477 files, 8893 tests passed.
- On `0842cef6` (the same source as the final head for these packages, before merging `main`, whose incoming commits touch none of these doors): `@objectstack/runtime` 8529 passed / 19 skipped; `@objectstack/rest` 6827 passed / 344 skipped; `@objectstack/client` 678 passed; `@objectstack/plugin-security` 5049 passed / 45 skipped; `@objectstack/cli` unit layer 4951 passed (the integration layer is declared to CI).
- `typecheck` exit 0 on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/objectql`.
- First run, before the fixture fixes: metadata-protocol 30 failed in 4 files and objectql 6 failed in 1 file, every one a double or boot that never installed the package its rows were bound to (listed under Fixtures above).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Studio still shows "Package not found" for a phantom id (#26708), so the way out (delete, discard, or create the package) is a REST or SDK act, not a Studio one.
- A phantom id that the install door refuses as a package id (for example one with underscores) cannot be brought back by creating the package; its rows can still be deleted and discarded.
- The draft address is now read for every type's draft save naming no package (it was read for `object` only): two `sys_metadata` reads, active and draft, the reads `resolveWriteHead` makes for the same save.

## Verification

- Live red/green on the real REST door, same probe on both trees (`pnpm dev -- -p PORT --database file:DB`, signed in as the seeded dev admin). The database is a copy of one snapshot written by `main` before #26920 (`7eb613c3`): five dashboards saved with `?package=com.example.nosuch` (active, active + draft, draft only), all 200 there.

<details><summary>Red on the base (`25a697ec`, #26920 merged) vs green on this branch</summary>

| Request (no package installed under `com.example.nosuch`) | Base | This branch |
|---|---|---|
| `PUT /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_a?package=com.example.nosuch` (control: #26708's rule) | 422 | 422, unchanged sentence |
| `PUT /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_d` (active row bound to the id) | 200, receipt `package=com.example.nosuch` | 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`; `GET` still serves label `Ghost D` |
| `PUT /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_a?mode=draft` | 200, draft stored bound to the id | 422; `GET ?state=draft` answers 404 `NO_DRAFT` (nothing written) |
| `POST /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_e/publish?package=com.example.nosuch` | 200, draft served live | 422; `GET` still serves the old active label `Ghost E` |
| `POST /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_c/publish` (lone phantom draft, no package named) | 200, served live | 422; `GET` 404 (still not live) |
| `POST /packages/com.example.nosuch/publish-drafts` (control) | 404 | 404 |
| Control: `POST /packages` `app.probe1` (201), save into it, save naming none, draft, publish `?package=app.probe1` | 200 ×4, rows bound to `app.probe1` | the same |
| Control: package-less `plain_dash` save, draft, publish | 200 ×3 | the same |
| `DELETE /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_b?package=com.example.nosuch` (the way out) | 200, then `GET` 404 | the same |

Inherited-save sentence as served (length 423 for these names, under the 500-character client bound): "Cannot save dashboard 'ghost_dash_d' without naming a package: its stored rows are bound to package 'com.example.nosuch', which is not installed in this deployment, and this save would extend that binding. Create a package with that id first, or remove the rows bound to it (a delete naming that package; discard-drafts for drafts) and save again, into an installed writable package or with no package. Nothing was written."

</details>

- Measure-first, on the pre-#26920 tree with the same snapshot: `DELETE /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_a` (no package) 200 and `GET` 404; `DELETE …ghost_dash_d?package=com.example.nosuch` 200; `DELETE …ghost_dash_b?state=draft&package=com.example.nosuch` 200 and the draft read 404 `NO_DRAFT`; `POST /packages` with id `com.example.nosuch` 201, then `PUT /meta/dashboard/ghost_dash_e` naming none 200 with the row still bound to that (now installed) id. The two doors this PR closes are not on any of those paths.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head `6135db9b`: 101 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all 101 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

<details><summary>The two first-run reds and what cleared them</summary>

- `check:engine-double-contract` exit 1: the new test file's engine double answers `delete`, `findOne` and `update` the ledger did not record ("New pinned coverage is GOOD … Run `--write`"). Recorded with `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write` (commit `6135db9b`), then exit 0.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3: the shallow clone lacked its positive-control commit; after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…`, exit 0. Not a finding.
- The ledger commit moved the derived set by 8 families (`scripts/**` now in the change set); those 8 were run on `6135db9b`, all exit 0.

</details>

- Full dogfood once (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, after a full build, 116/116 tasks) on `16162380` (this branch after merging `main` at `3230bdbf`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 346 passed / 3 skipped, Tests 2794 passed / 20 skipped. The only commit after it, `6135db9b`, adds three rows to `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, which no dogfood test reads.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Root ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the 7 touched TS files: exit 0.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
